findings.title: Isla Community Health Announces Temporary Pause of Kagman Clinic Services While Planning to Strengthen and Expand Community Healthcare Access
findings.publisher: Marianas Press (Isla Community Health provider press release)
findings.exact_supporting_passage: announces the temporary closure of its Kagman clinic location, effective October 30, 2026
findings.territory: Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands
findings.access_consequences: Kagman clinic site temporarily closed because typhoon-damaged building is unsuitable for safe occupancy. Patients must obtain continued primary/preventive care from Southern Isla Community Health in San Antonio, Saipan. Relocation creates potential transportation/access barriers; provider is exploring assistance. No confirmed date to reopen Kagman site.
findings.affected_population: Kagman clinic patients and residents of Kagman and surrounding northern/eastern Saipan communities; patient count not reported.

coverage_notes.scope: United States, District of Columbia, and U.S. territories; high-value healthcare access loss, CMS actions, EMS/air-medical changes, and concrete restorations.
